name: Emberton
reasoning: I conducted extensive grid searches and randomized simulations in the sandbox to tune the weights and threshold. To maximize wins against the highly aggressive template opponent (who spams Pyroclasm), we open with Pyroclasm on turn 1 to match their damage and secure one-shot kills against Flora and Aqua targets. We then chip with Ember or use Pyroclasm for the kill on subsequent turns. We use Mend to outlast the opponent when our HP falls below 20% (preventing wasting turns healing too early). With low aggression (0.1), we maintain defensive control, proving that patience beats power.
